linkedin:
A bad study-abroad consultant can cost you more than money — they can cost you years.

Not every agent is honest. Watch for these 6 red flags before you commit:
1) Pushes the same country/university on everyone
2) Promises a "100% guaranteed" visa
3) Won't explain what you're actually paying for
4) Rushes you to pay "today only"
5) No track record, no references
6) Never asks about your actual goal

A good consultant changes your life. A bad one takes your money.
